messages:
Maria C: Heads-up — dashboards showing a big drop in structured telemetry from eu-west-1 since last deploy. panels for gpu_pod_envelopes_total down ~60% :eyes:
Aj Patel: I saw that too. Prometheus shows scrape success ~100%, but the ingestion rate into the JSON pipeline is much lower.
Kevin L: Any specific keys missing? last rollout changed the compacting transform to drop empty fields.
Maria C: It's the 'session_meta' envelope; several required fields (region, gpu_count) are now null/absent. affects autoscaler signals and SLO math.
Ben S: Could be the new compact-keys rule in pipeline v3.0. We added aggressive key compacting to save bandwidth in private deployments.
Lina H: If autoscaler can't see gpu_count we end up scale跌? (typo) — we mis-scale and keep more nodes, cost spike noted in billing report.
Aj Patel: Logging pipeline trace shows a 1:1 mapping loss at the sampler: sample_id 9c3f... it returns compacted payloads with top-level metadata moved to kv -> null.
Kevin L: Reproduced locally. Older agents (agent v1.7) emit full 'session_meta'. New transform (v3) compacted nested objects into 'kvs' array when fields under threshold.
Maria C: Proposed immediate action: revert compacting transform in eu-west-1 to preserve gpu_count and region, then push a corrected transform that keeps whitelist fields.
Ben S: Agreed. Also we need a short-term prom-rule tweak: don't rely on gpu_pod_envelopes_total alone for autoscaler alerts. Add fallback metric gpu_pod_count:sum and a runbook note.
Lina H: I'll open a CANARY revert PR for eu-west-1 and patch mapping rules.
Aj Patel: Sample mapping snippet to land in PR:
```
# mapping patch
preserve_fields: ["session_meta.region","session_meta.gpu_count","host.zone"]
compacting_policy: "whitelist-first"
```
Kevin L: And PII note: don't preserve raw user_email. Use pseudonymization tokenization instead. e.g. hash(email) with salt.
Maria C: Correct. We should redact per-policy for EU and use pseudonymization for non-PHI. Draft rule:
```
redact_rules:
  - field: user_email
    action: pseudonymize
    algo: sha256
    salt_kms: projects/redwood/kms/telemetry
```
Aj Patel: Good. Also update schema v3 docs to include 'compatibilityMode: strict|lax' and default to lax for 72h in rollout.
Ben S: Timeline: revert now (10m), deploy patch (1-2h), canary 24h, finalize 72h. I'll add to the incident timeline.
ops-bot: Deploy started: revert-telemetry-compact-euw triggered by Lina H — build #3821
sre-bot: Alert muted: gpu_telemetry_missing_eu — 30m mute by Maria C :white_check_mark:
Lina H: Revert landed to eu-west-1, watch panels. I'll run a small traffic replay to validate preserved fields.
Aj Patel: Also opening a Grafana dashboard panel tweak: change query from:
```
sum(rate(gpu_pod_envelopes_total[5m])) by (region)
```
to
```
sum(rate(gpu_pod_envelopes_total[5m]) OR vector(0)) by (region) + sum(gpu_pod_count) by(region)
```
(to avoid 0->NA causing abrupt scaling decisions)
Kevin L: We should add an SLO synthetic check that emits a 'telemetry-heartbeat' metric from each node every 5m. If a node misses 3 heartbeats, trigger separate ticket.
Maria C: Agree. This will decouple autoscaler from log ingestion reliability.
Ben S: Cost note — the compacting change saved ~15% ingress cost, but regression caused 3x downstream autoscale cost in eu-west-1 for a 6h window. Need to put a safety threshold for compacting savings.
Lina H: I'll add that to the Optimize playbook: require simulated autoscaler impact test before enabling compacting >10% savings in any region.
Maria C: Thanks team. Post-mortem follow up will include: mapping checklist, prom rule fallback, canary window, pseudonymization cookbook, cost-safety gate.
Aj Patel: I'll file the post-mortem and link runbook + PRs. :shipit:
Ben S: LGTM
Kevin L: :thumbsup:
sre-bot: Deploy finished: revert-telemetry-compact-euw succeeded — all checks passed
Maria C: Panels look back to normal. Closing thread, will keep monitoring for 24h.
